_about: Stage B's fishing and cooking (scripts/camp/camp_pack.gd). A player fishes within the radius (metres) of a water model's centre in data/clearing.json and grills at a fire model's; each takes cast_s or cook_s of real time and never fails. A catch is picked by weight. Grilling turns the first raw fish in your Pack into its recipe. Catches and meals go into the Pack (data/items.json), and grilling burns fuel from there. The bobber shows where the line is while fishing, cast_m ahead of the player.
